data.name: AlGhaffar
data.gender_notes: AlGhaffar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: AlGhaffar refers to Allah (God), the most Forgiving and Merciful One. He forgives the sins of those who repent and seek His forgiveness. The name AlGhaffar carries the meaning “The Forgiver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlGhaffar usually hope their child will grow to embody the forgiver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May Allah (God) grant us the ability to forgive and seek forgiveness.
data.etymology: AlGhaffar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Forgiver.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlGhaffar total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: الغفار
in_arabic.meaning: الغفار هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني الذي يغفر الذنوب
in_arabic.long_meaning: الغفار هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني الذي يغفر الذنوب ويستر العيوب، وهو اسم الفاعل من غفر، يغفر غفرانا، والغفران هو ستر الذنوب وترك العقوبة على صاحبها. ورد اسم الله الغفار في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'والله الغفور الرحيم'.

in_urdu.name: الغفار
in_urdu.meaning: الغفار اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، معنی ہے جس جو پاپوں کو معاف کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: الغفار اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، معنی ہے جس جو پاپوں کو معاف کرتا ہے اور اپنے بندوں کی خطائیں چھپاتا ہے۔ یہ نام غفر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے پاپوں کو معاف کرنا اور اپنے بندوں پر عذاب سے گریز کرنا۔ قرآن کریم میں اس نام کا ذکر کئی جگہوں پر کیا گیا ہے، جیسے کہ ارشاد ربانی: 'اور اللہ تعالیٰ غفور اور رحیم ہے'۔

in_hindi.name: अल-ग़फ़्फ़ार
in_hindi.meaning: अल-ग़फ़्फ़ार ईश्वर के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है जो पापों को क्षमा करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अल-ग़फ़्फ़ार ईश्वर के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है जो पापों को क्षमा करता है और अपने सेवकों की गलतियों को छुपाता है। यह नाम 'ग़फ़र' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है पापों को क्षमा करना और अपने सेवकों पर सज़ा से बचना। कुरआन में इस नाम का उल्लेख कई स्थानों पर किया गया है, जैसे कि रब्बानी आदेश: 'और अल्लाह अत्यंत क्षमाशील और दयालु है'।

in_pashto.name: الغفار
in_pashto.meaning: الغفار د الله ښوو نومونو څخه يو دی، معنی یې دى هغه کوم چې ګناهونه وبخښي
in_pashto.long_meaning: الغفار د الله ښوو نومونو څخه يو دی، معنی یې دى هغه کوم چې ګناهونه وبخښي او د خپلو بندګانو پټي يې رابخښي. دا نوم د غفر څخه اخستل شوی دی، چي معنی یې د ګناهونو بخښل او د خپلو بندګانو څخه د سزا ګریز دی. په قرآن کريم کې ددې نوم ذکر په ډیرو ځايونو کې شوی دی، لکه د رباني ارشاد: 'او الله تعالیٰ ډیر بخښوونکی او مهربان دی'.

in_english.name: AlGhaffar
in_english.meaning: AlGhaffar is one of Allah's beautiful names, meaning The Forgiving One
in_english.long_meaning: AlGhaffar is one of Allah's beautiful names, meaning The Forgiving One, who pardons sins and covers the faults of His servants. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'ghafara', which means to forgive sins and to protect from punishment. The name AlGhaffar is mentioned in the Quran several times, such as: 'And Allah is Ever-Forgiving, Most Merciful'. This name reflects the attribute of Allah's forgiveness and mercy towards His servants, emphasizing His benevolence and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name AlGhaffar holds significant cultural significance in the Islamic world, as it emphasizes the mercy and forgiveness of Allah. It is a reminder of His divine attributes, which are highly revered and central to Islamic belief. The name also inspires Muslims to strive towards forgiveness, not just for their own sins, but for the sins of others as well.
data.spiritual_significance: AlGhaffar represents the essence of Allah's infinite mercy and forgiveness. It offers spiritual comfort and strength, reminding Muslims that no matter how great their sins may be, they can always turn to Allah for forgiveness. This name encourages Muslims to seek His forgiveness and to cultivate a deep sense of remorse and repentance. AlGhaffar is a source of inspiration and encouragement, urging Muslims to strive for a better, more virtuous life.

He forgives the sins of those who repent and seek His forgiveness.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name AlGhaffar serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the forgiver.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Ghaffar is a title given to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) in the Quran. The name AlGhaffar carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Al-Ghaffar is one of the names of Allah and is also a title given to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) in the Quran. It means 'the Forgiving'. This name is mentioned in Surah Al-Fajr (89:27-30).

modern_usage.modern_context: The name AlGhaffar remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
